title: Hunts FH-032T: Send the finale notice to players
detail: Route health shows whether the finale notice went out (lib/hunts/rally-finale.ts finaleBroadcastState over outbox rows of type finale.broadcast), and nothing writes such a row, so every Trail with a finale reads Not sent. Owed by an agent: when a Trail with a host Event is published, or when the organiser asks, write one outbox row per player with a run, of type FINALE_BROADCAST_EVENT, with a semantic key per player and Event so a replay sends once; add the consumer that delivers it through the existing worker (behind HUNTS_WORKER_ENABLED); the words point at the Event page and never promise a seat. Owner decision first (Daniel): who is told (every player with a run, or only finishers) and when (at publish, a set time before the Event, or by hand). Done when an organiser sends the notice on a preview deployment and route health moves from Not sent to Sent. Requires FH-031S. Hunts switches stay OFF.
